message_source_quote: The reading list's white-bear paper (same model, same family, same read window) identified the actual mechanism: the direction must sit in the **mid-depth band (20–24)** at a **large dose**, where the layers above the band *compute* the implied concept into the read position — the vector is not read back. I calibrated its recipe exactly (reproduced their read-cell-only number: 0.43 ≈ 0.44).
